tagline: The Lakeflow Designer September release adds Guardrails, multi input joins, new parameter controls, and more ways to bring data into a visual data prep.
what_it_does: The Lakeflow Designer September release adds Guardrails, multi input joins, new parameter controls, and more ways to bring data into a visual data prep. The following updates are now available: Create a visual data prep from multiple files: On the Visual data prep page, select Import file As source to upload multiple files into one visual data prep, with a Source operator for each file. Guardrails operator: Check data against rules such as not null, unique, and accepted values.
why_it_matters: When the side pane is open, the in canvas toolbar is minimized.
